recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Do not remove or deprecate the 'unit' item-control code in FHIR-core because core no longer owns that source; any future work should be raised against the FHIR Extension Pack and reconciled with FHIR-50277.
issue_request: FHIR-37617 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core Questionnaire change request to remove the 'unit' display item-ControlType code because questionnaire-unit could serve the same purpose.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites Git 1197ebc. That commit is in the FHIR Extension Pack, not current FHIR-core, and applied the issue by deprecating the questionnaire-item-control 'unit' concept and adding deprecation metadata rather than deleting the code.
additional_context: Questionnaire remains active in FHIR-core, but current core source has no CodeSystem-questionnaire-item-control, ValueSet-questionnaire-item-control, or StructureDefinition-questionnaire-itemControl source beyond OID mappings. The artifact now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack. A later FHIR-extensions issue, FHIR-50277, concluded that questionnaire-unit is not equivalent for custom UI unit displays and commit 630a5f849fafd7e14a7add6549debdf3c2189650 removed the FHIR-37617 deprecation state.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source was changed. The reconciliation published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch documenting that any remaining item-control terminology change belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack and must consider the later FHIR-50277 reversal.

related_jiras.note: FHIR Extension Pack issue that reinstated/undeprecated the same questionnaire-item-control 'unit' code because questionnaire-unit did not provide equivalent custom UI display behavior.

evidence_items.learned: The replacement mechanism exists externally, but current external guidance still allows the separate unit display item for non-equivalent display cases.

evidence_items.learned: The initial application was external-pack deprecation rather than a current core source removal.

evidence_items.summary: Later FHIR-extensions issue requested reinstating 'unit' because questionnaire-unit does not provide equivalent custom UI display behavior.
evidence_items.learned: This later decision explains why current external source no longer carries the FHIR-37617 deprecation/removal state.

evidence_items.summary: The Extension Pack commit for FHIR-50277 removed deprecated status/deprecationDate from 'unit' and replaced the definition with nuanced guidance.
